I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread: the ticket is **#88412**.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025, and Hollis is a member of that channel. It was a Tier 2 escalation for Tansleigh Packaging. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 froze while scanning BOL barcodes, apparently when Quarendon Freightways drivers arrived with split manifests.

I also told Hollis not to confuse it with #8841, a similar-looking number that Tobias mentioned yesterday in #central-random. That ticket is about Door 2 double-booking on the dealer account.

There are no Tansleigh account files in the share, so that Slack message is the only record I found. It doesn't say whether the ticket is still open.
